name: Amphibians
description: Salamanders, Frogs, Toads, Newts, etc.

name: Angels
description: Angels or other celestials, typically magical.

name: Animals / Ferals
description: Refers to the preference and / or interest in partners whose characters are non-sentient, and typically quadrupedal and / or non-anthropomorphized, animals, which may or may not necessarily be anatomically accurate in regard to body size.

name: Avians
description: Birds, gryphons, phoenixes, rocs, chimeras etc.

name: Bats
description: Bats and other true-flight mammals.

name: Bovines
description: Bulls, cows, buffalo etc.

name: Canines
description: Domesticated dogs, wolves, dingos, coyotes, jackals etc.

name: Caprinae
description: Sheep, goats, etc.

name: Cervines
description: Deer, elk, moose etc.

name: Demons
description: Demons or devils, typically magical. May also include other, fantastical creatures, such as but not limited to Incubi, Succubi, and fiends.

name: Digimon
description: Characters from the manga and television show "Digimon",

name: Dinosaurs
description: Prehistoric species such as tyrannosaurus rex, triceratops, raptors, apatosaurus, etc.

name: Divinities
description: Gods, goddesses, demi-gods and demi-goddesses of all sorts, ranging from those barely more powerful than a mortal to the nearly omnipotent.

name: Dragons
description: Dragons, drakes, wyverns, etc.

name: Driders
description: Describes a kind of species that is a combination of human and spider. Usually, their anatomy consists of a (mostly) humanoid upper body seated on top of the body of a spider. It may refer to hybrids with mostly humanoid or arachnid features as well.

name: Elves
description: Humanoid individuals characterized by long pointed ears and typically containing fantasy elements.

name: Equines
description: Horses, donkeys, mules, zebra, centauri etc.

name: Exotic Species
description: Expresses an interest for uncommon, hybrid or otherwise exotic choices in species.

name: Fae
description: Beings of the mythical and supernatural variety, generally consisting of things such as fairies, imps, spirits, elementals, etc.

name: Felines
description: Domesticated cats, jaguars, lions, tigers, cheetahs etc.

name: Fish / Sharks
description: Gill-bearing aquatic animals such Great Whites, Tiger sharks, Whale sharks, and various types of fish.

name: Humanoids
description: Characters that have a humanoid shape but are not human. Examples may consist of various races such as satyrs, gnomes, dwarves, halflings, tieflings, etc.

name: Humans
description: Characters that are purely human, generally realistic, and generally contain no fantasy or supernatural elements (but not necessarily).

name: Hyaenidae
description: Hyenas!

name: Insects / Arachnids
description: Bees, wasps, spiders, scorpions, ants etc.

name: Kemonomimi
description: Characters with animal ears, a tail, or other animal characteristics on an otherwise human body.

name: Lamia / Naga
description: Characters with lower bodies (typically serpentine) that do not possess legs, with their lower extremities being more akin to a snake, eel, worm, fish, or similar.

name: Lapines
description: Bunnies, rabbits, hares etc.

name: Lycanthropes
description: A character with the ability and/or condition to transform into an animal or particular non-human beast (generally an anthropomorphic animal or animal-like creature). Examples of such would be werewolves, werecats, and all forms of general werebeasts.

name: Mammals
description: Any character belonging to the Mammalia class.

name: Marine Mammals
description: Whales, dolphins, etc.

name: Marsupials
description: Kangaroos, koala, possums, wombats etc.

name: Mephitis
description: Skunks, basically!

name: Mollusca
description: Slugs, snails, oysters, squids, octopuses, etc.

name: Monkeys / Primates
description: Apes, monkeys, chimps, gorillas, etc.

name: Monsters
description: Various types of monsters and aesthetically challenging characters.

name: Moogles
description: Moogles are a recurring race from the Final Fantasy computer games. They have small wings, usually pink / white fur and a pom-pom hanging from their heads.

name: Mustelidae
description: Minks, ferrets, weasels, stoats, otters, wolverines, martens etc.

name: My Little Pony
description: Characters from, or related to, the television show “My Little Pony.”

name: Orcs
description: A race of humanlike creatures, normally larger than humans and green skinned. They are typically characterized as brutish and aggressive (but not necessarily so).

name: Parasites
description: Expresses an interest in characters being infested with a parasitic organism or hosting one, or involving parasitic characters in general.

name: Plants
description: Any form of plant life, vegetation or character composed partially, or fully, there-of.

name: Pokémon
description: Characters from the manga and television show "Pokemon".

name: Predator Species
description: Expresses a preference for characters which are often perceived to be predatorial, e.g. wolves, hyenas, tigers, bears, dragons etc.

name: Prey Species
description: Expresses a preference for characters which are often perceived to be meek or preyed upon, e.g. mice, deer, raccoons, bunnies etc.

name: Procyonidae
description: Raccoons, coatimundi, longtails etc.

name: Reptiles
description: Chameleons, anoles, alligators, snakes, crocodiles, lizards, etc.

name: Robots, Cyborgs, Androids
description: Manufactured or partially manufactured life forms.

name: Rodents / Murines
description: Rats, mice, chipmunks, squirrels, etc.

name: Sentient Cocks
description: Expresses interest in cocks that are sentient. It might have the ability to twist and coil, move by itself, the external urethral orifice able to open and close at will, or be entirely stand alone without an attached "host." May have a more serpent-like appearance.

name: Taurs
description: Characters having an upper torso adjoining a lower quadrupedal body where the creature's head should normally appear. Includes centaurs, chakats, etc.

name: Undead
description: The undead. Zombies, and other undead creatures.

name: Ursines
description: Bears! Bears! Bears!

name: Vampires
description: Vampiric characters, not necessarily humanoid.

name: Vulpines
description: Foxes, fennecs, kitsune etc.

name: Xeno / Alien
description: Extraterrestrial or otherwise alien / abnormal characters.
